english.note: Use this colloquial phrasing when you want to make clear that the housemaster is a teacher supervising the school dormitory.

examples.english: If you have any dormitory problems, you can go straight to the housemaster.
examples.traditional: 有咩宿舍問題，你可以直接搵宿舍老師。
